Playback design comparisons

Ideas for the whole playback experience: layout, seeking, chapters, settings, narration and recovery. Each topic compares the current layout with two directions. The proposals keep the same book, typography, palette and matching secondary playback buttons.

My starting point: a mix of B and C. Use the chapter-first player, clearer timer status and descriptive narration choices from B. Use the simpler inline and reading controls from C. Add seek preview and undo, then tune speed and chapter discovery. Each topic includes its own tradeoffs; these are proposals, not changes to the application.
